summary: Sanara MedTech Inc. (SMTI) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with MiMedx Group, Inc. (Parent) and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mustang Merger Sub, Inc. The merger subsidiary will merge into Sanara, with Sanara surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. Under the terms, each share of Sanara common stock (excluding appraisal and excluded shares) will be converted into the right to receive $33.00 per share in cash. Sanara's board unanimously approved the merger, deemed it fair, and recommended stockholders vote in favor. The deal is subject to stockholder approval and other customary conditions. Watch for regulatory and shareholder approval timeline and any competing bids.
